newsitem.title: INDIA: India state estimates cyclone damage to rice crop.
newsitem.headline: India state estimates cyclone damage to rice crop.

text.p: Officials from the cyclone-ravaged southeast Indian state of Andhra Pradesh estimated on Friday that the storm had destroyed a standing rice crop covering 435,000 hectares (1.07 million acres).

The state's relief commissioner H.S. Brahma gave the estimates during a press briefing in which the death toll from the storm was put at 477 people. Senior state government officials expect the number of dead to rise to around 1,000.

Around 180,000 hectares (444,780 acres) of harvested paddy fields were also flooded by the torrential rain and tidal waters that hit the Konaseema area, known as the rice bowl of the state, on Wednesday night.
And some 312,000 hectares (770,952 acres) under cultivation for other crops, primarily banana plantations, coconut groves and chiles, were also swamped.
